name: Nose Geometry
algorithm: Nose Geometry — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes nose geometry for deepfake detection:

1. **NoseLandmark跟踪**: Detailed nose landmarks — bridge, tip, alae (wings), nostrils, columella, nasion (bridge root) — are tracked per frame. These landmarks define the nose's 3D geometry projected into 2D.

2. **几何Proportion分析**: Nose proportions should follow anatomical constraints: bridge width vs. alar width, nostril size relative to nose length, tip protrusion relative to bridge height. The method checks whether proportions remain within normal human ranges and are consistent across frames. Deepfakes may produce floating proportions.

3. **3DShape一致性**: The nose is a prominent 3D structure that should show consistent self-occlusion and shading as head pose changes. The method verifies that nose appearance changes (nostril visibility, bridge shadow, tip highlight) are geometrically consistent with the estimated head pose. AI generators may produce incorrect nose shading at certain poses.

4. **Nose-人脸整合**: The nose must integrate seamlessly with surrounding facial features — nasolabial folds connect nose to cheeks, bridge connects to brow ridge, and skin texture continues smoothly. The method checks for boundary artifacts around the nose perimeter. Face-swap blending may be visible at nose boundaries.

5. **时间Shape稳定性**: Nose cartilage provides a rigid structure — nose geometry shouldn't change between frames (only viewing angle changes). The method tracks nose proportions over time. Frame-to-frame variation in nose proportions indicates AI generation where the nose is independently rendered each frame.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through nose geometry analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
